scope: Apply Capture visual philosophy to existing Manager UI; no lifecycle, native permission, consent or data-contract changes; main completion Goal stays paused.

research.interpretation: Tauri web controls use semantic CSS and native select/keyboard behavior. This is not a replacement with SwiftUI/AppKit and does not claim native macOS menu integration.

findings_fixed: Hard-coded green colors and light-only forms replaced with shared Capture teal and semantic light/dark tokens.
Deployment preparation preceded daily exhibition controls; preparation now follows core operation and recovery sections.
Long page lacked direct task access; anchor navigation exposes exhibition, backup/restore, update, job history and deployment preparation without remounting work modules.
Long OEX instructions moved into a details disclosure; the original OEX action and permission guard remain visible.
Long-window task navigation now stays sticky; desktop and narrow anchor/focus clearance prevents headings and skip-link targets from hiding beneath the menu.

design.font: System UI stack, existing responsive headings, body and supporting text
design.spacing: 8/12/16/24/32px semantic tokens; shared card padding24/16 and radius24
design.appearance: Header > 화면 모드: system/light/dark. Defaults to system; only explicit selection is stored under exhibitos.manager.appearance; live OS appearance changes observed in system mode. Restricted storage still applies current window selection.
design.motion: No new animation; existing reduced-motion support preserved.

preservation.actions: Existing React action callbacks, Rust core, invocation API, disabled/active guard expressions and all lifecycle consent contents unchanged. All stateful work panels remain mounted.
preservation.data: No server, engine, key, backup, actual installation, container, VM or user-data operation executed.
preservation.storage: No lifecycle path or secret persisted by the new preference; existing empty-storage operation checks retained.
